title: ‘Clarkson’s Farm’ star Kaleb Cooper headlines new series ‘Kaleb Off the Farm,’ coming to Prime Video January 8
summary: Kaleb trades the English countryside for the Outback, with a dream of making it in Australian farming.
body_markdown:

## Key takeaways


- Kaleb Off the Farm


premieres on Prime Video on January 8, 2027, worldwide.


- It follows


Clarkson


’


s Farm


breakout star Kaleb Cooper on his first solo trip abroad.


- He visits Australia, chasing his dream of owning his own farm.

[Prime Video](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/tag/prime-video) has revealed a first look at the upcoming series


Kaleb Off the Farm


, starring


[Clarkson’s Farm](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/clarksons-farm-season-5-prime-video) breakout star Kaleb Cooper.


The show follows Kaleb’s adventures Down Under as he heads from Diddly Squat Farm to the Outback, in search of farming gold in Australia.


Here’s everything you need to know about the new series, which arrives on Prime Video globally on January 8, 2027.


## What is ‘Kaleb Off the Farm’ about?


Kaleb Cooper is a country lad at heart: happiest on a tractor and firmly within the familiar confines of Chipping Norton. But there’s one thing he wants more than anything: his own farm.


With the winter months putting his agricultural dreams on ice, he’s hatched a cunning plan—he’s off to Australia, where the grass is greener, the sun always shines, and surely nobody has ever complained about the weather.


['Clarkson's Farm' special 'Jeremy Grows a Car' coming to Prime Video in 2027](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/clarksons-farm-special-jeremy-grows-a-car-prime-video)


Jeremy Clarkson is going back to his automotive roots by building his own car using produce from his farm.


On his first-ever solo trip abroad—and first time on a plane—Kaleb heads Down Under with dreams of striking it rich in Australian farming. But first he’ll need to conquer wheat fields the size of small countries, round up wild cattle on horseback, and learn the hard way that crocodiles aren’t just oversized farm dogs.


Will his gamble pay off, or will it leave him sunburnt, broke, and heading home with diddly squat?


Kaleb Off the Farm


is produced by Dragonfly (a Banijay UK company) for Prime Video.


## When is the ‘Kaleb Off the Farm’ release date?


The four-part UK Original series will be released exclusively on Prime Video on January 8, 2027, in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide.


If you want to catch up with Kaleb and the rest of the


Clarkson


’


s Farm
